messages:
Maria G: Quick sync — Q3 runtime trade-off call. We need to pick priorities between kernel fusion (big-seq perf) and quant rollout (cost). FinServ-Alpha is pushing hard on p99 latency for long sequences. Can we triage scope and launch criteria?
Raj P: Short take — kernel fusion gives ~1.6x throughput for seq > 2048 but raises peak mem ~20%. Quant (4-bit) drops GPU mem ~40% and cost by ~30% but has some quality risk on chat flows.
Kevin L: Bench data on rtx-a6000: fusion-only p95=95ms @512 tokens; quantized p95=110ms but cost -35%. For long seq (>2k) quant p99 tail worse than fusion.
Angela S: Customer requirement: p99 <= 250ms for 2k seq, and they require no perceptible quality regressions. Quant-only rollout probably fails that bar unless we gate on prompt types.
Luis M: Suggest split-scope: prioritize kernel fusion as primary perf path for long sequences; implement adaptive quant for lower-risk routes (embeddings, batch scoring). Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with gating metrics.
Raj P: Implementation note — need robust fallback when fusion causes OOM: auto-fallback to quant variant of same model id. Also autoscaler thresholds must be tuned because fusion increases instantaneous mem.
Maria G: Draft launch criteria: (a) p95 <= 120ms for seq <= 512 (prod-backed tests); (b) p99 <= 250ms for seq <= 2048; (c) automated eval: <1% quality drop on our regression suites; (d) OOM rate < 0.1% during canary.
Kevin L: Who owns eval gating? Perf team or model-onboarding? We need CI runs that compare fusion vs baseline and quant vs baseline. Suggest perf-ci-bot run nightly/regression and post diffs.
perf-ci-bot: perf-ci-bot: scheduled job created: perf/regressions/fusion_quant_weekly — will post perf + quality diffs to #eng-runtime/reporting.
Angela S: Ops idea: tune KV cache TTL / hot-prefix retention to reduce p99 tails — e.g., bump hot-prefix cache from 5m -> 30m for customers with high repeat prefixes. That can buy headroom during canary.
Luis M: Action items: 1) Raj + Kevin: mem profiling spike for fusion this sprint (deliverable: mem map + max resident metrics). 2) Angela: coordinate canary with Cust-Alpha and set SLIs. 3) Maria: update product/roadmap ticket with split-scope + launch criteria. 4) perf-ci-bot: add Cust-Alpha eval prompt set and schedule diffs.
Maria G: :thumbsup: Thanks — we'll review progress in Thu planning. If anyone objects to the split-scope approach speak up now.
